title: Can you calculate the median from the highest season goals of each team?
question: Can you calculate the median from the highest season goals of each team?

prediction.sql:
WITH team_season AS (
  SELECT home_team_api_id AS team_id, season, SUM(home_team_goal) AS goals
  FROM Match
  GROUP BY home_team_api_id, season
  UNION ALL
  SELECT away_team_api_id AS team_id, season, SUM(away_team_goal) AS goals
  FROM Match
  GROUP BY away_team_api_id, season
),
team_max AS (
  SELECT team_id, MAX(goals) AS max_goals
  FROM team_season
  GROUP BY team_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT max_goals,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_goals) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER () AS n
  FROM team_max
)
SELECT AVG(max_goals) AS median
FROM ranked
WHERE rn IN ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2)
